items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: I just took the book and I put the arrangement in Andy's band, and Andy featured me on it.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's what I called it, right. But I did that... I just took the book and I put the arrangement in Andy's band, and Andy featured me on it. You know, after hearing it, he liked it, and he said, "Well, it looks good; we'll keep it in the book." And most of my music he liked, you know. I wrote "Seven Come Eleven" and things that Benny made...
